title: Dual-Theme SaaS Pricing & Dashboard System in Pure Modern CSS
brief: Build a responsive Light/Dark SaaS pricing matrix and analytics grid powered strictly by modern CSS: @layer architecture, OKLCH custom properties, Container Queries for portable cards, CSS Subgrid for row alignment, :has() interactive billing toggle styling, and prefers-reduced-motion compositor animations.

requirements.text: Organize styles into explicit @layer reset, tokens, layout, components, utilities.
Define Light and Dark semantic tokens using CSS custom properties and oklch() colors meeting WCAG AA (4.5:1+) contrast.
Build an intrinsic responsive pricing card grid with CSS Grid and align card titles, prices, and CTA buttons across columns using CSS Subgrid.
Implement a Container Query (@container) card component that switches from stacked to horizontal layout when its host is >= 460px wide.
Style the monthly/annual billing toggle and highlighted plan card purely via CSS :has(input:checked).
Add compositor-only hover transitions (transform, opacity) and wrap motion cleanly with @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce).

steps.title: Establish Cascade Layers & Reset
steps.details: Declare @layer order at the top of styles.css and apply border-box + font: inherit resets.

steps.title: Build OKLCH Dual-Theme Tokens
steps.details: Create :root and .dark semantic variables for canvas, surface, border, primary text, muted text, and indigo accent.

steps.title: Compose the Subgrid Pricing Matrix
steps.details: Set up a 3-column grid with minmax(0, 1fr) and configure each card with grid-row: span 4; grid-template-rows: subgrid;.

steps.title: Add Container Query Portability
steps.details: Wrap feature callouts in container-type: inline-size so the same card adapts inside sidebars and main columns.

steps.title: Wire :has() Interactive States
steps.details: Highlight the selected plan card border and elevation using .plan-card:has(input:checked) without extra state classes.

steps.title: Polish Motion & Accessibility
steps.details: Add 180ms compositor-only hover transitions, tabular-nums on pricing metrics, and prefers-reduced-motion safeguards.
